title: The Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework: Scalable Multimodal UX Attribution in Web Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.27899v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sustaining user experience (UX) quality in large-scale web search requires scalable evaluation. Traditional surveys are slow and bottleneck rapid A/B testing, while automated metrics often lack the granularity to diagnose visual-spatial UX anomalies. To address this, we introduce the Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework, a novel industrial architecture for automated UX attribution. Tier 1 (Macro System) acts as a scalable user sentiment regression detector, utilizing a fine-tuned encoder-decoder LLM (based on Gemini XS) on telemetry features. Through multi-task regularization and contextual feature engineering, this tier achieves a +9.8% PR-AUC gain on over 500,000 held-out records, matching baseline recall on all validated regressions with $\sim$20% relative precision gain among the 12 held-out experiments. translated_title: 双层情感框架：网络搜索中可扩展的多模态用户体验归因
translated_abstract: 在大规模网络搜索中维持用户体验（UX）质量需要可扩展的评估方法。传统问卷调查速度缓慢，成为快速A/B测试的瓶颈，而自动化指标往往缺乏诊断视觉空间UX异常所需的粒度。为此，我们提出了双层情感框架（Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework），这是一种用于自动化UX归因的新型工业架构。第一层（宏观系统）作为可扩展的用户情感回归检测器，在遥测特征上利用微调的编码器-解码器大语言模型（基于Gemini XS）。通过多任务正则化和上下文特征工程，该层在超过50万条留存记录上实现了+9.8%的PR-AUC增益，在所有已验证的回归中与基线召回率持平，并在12个留存实验中实现了约20%的相对精确率提升。在生产环境中，该系统将测量延迟从数周缩短至数小时，并将问卷开销降低超过40%。第二层（微观系统）提供细粒度的诊断分析。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种双层情感框架，第一层利用微调的编码器-解码器大语言模型实现大规模用户情感回归检测（PR-AUC提升9.8%、测量延迟从数周降至数小时、问卷开销降低40%以上），第二层提供细粒度的UX归因诊断，从而实现网络搜索中可扩展的自动化用户体验评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework, where Tier 1 leverages a fine-tuned encoder-decoder LLM for scalable user sentiment regression detection (+9.8% PR-AUC gain, reducing measurement latency from weeks to hours and survey overhead by over 40%), and Tier 2 provides granular UX attribution diagnostics, enabling scalable automated UX evaluation in web search.
